top.title: Create the social accounts (Mastodon, Bluesky) and hand them to Aros — chamber#1, open 7 days 0 hours as of 22:43 UTC. It passed one week tonight at 22:17:48 UTC, the first item on this desk ever to do so, and no message was sent about it crossing: the hour was printed on this dashboard four days in advance so that passing it would need no message. It sits at the top because the item that used to (the agent GitHub account and its token) was ranked partly on the argument that the missing pull-request scope is what stops corrections being accepted, and qlever-dir#9 was filed, fixed and merged without that scope. chamber#1 is the phase exit — every bet in the strategy needs an audience, and there is none

others.title: Create a GitHub account for Aros, invite it to the org, and mint its token with contents + issues + pull-requests + repo-metadata scope — one action closes chamber#3 (he files issues from your account, which guardrail 8 forbids, and it is the standing violation on this list) and chamber#6 (no pull requests, no topics, no descriptions, no security settings, no comments on pull requests). Open 5 days 20 hours and 5 days 18 hours; both pass one week on 27 Jul. New argument for it tonight, from a different direction: because you and Aros post from the same account, the only thing that separates your issues from his is the AI-disclosure line guardrail 1 makes him write. That is what caught the standing measure counting six of your issues as his — it works, but a disclosure footer is a poor substitute for two accounts

Enable private vulnerability reporting on the four public repos — chamber#5, open 5 days 19 hours. Re-checked 2026-07-25 22:41 UTC: still false on all four. Your new SECURITY.md on the chamber branch gives a reporting path that does not depend on it, which fixes the worst half; the Code of Conduct's enforcement link still routes to the disabled feature. Verify your own fix with: gh api /repos/retinue-os/<repo>/private-vulnerability-reporting — it answers without admin scope

Merge (or reject) the branch claude/aros-issues-triage-goei5k on this chamber repo — it replaces the GUARDRAILS.md §3 CI row (chamber#7, open 5 days 18 hours) and adds SECURITY.md. Still unmerged with no pull request at 22:41; this repository has never had one. One change before merging: the row it adopts is Aros's own earlier wording, and its clause about the gateway's security-critical paths being untested is false as written — path traversal and SPARQL-injection containment are exercised in four test files. The corrected sentence ("endpoint authorization is untested by construction: no test constructs the gateway's request handler") is in a comment on chamber#7, posted 2026-07-25 16:40 UTC

Fix or triage the two security issues you filed — retinue#15 (credentials inherited by agent subsessions; this session carries a repo-write token, a billable API key, a gateway master key and a database password) and retinue#19 (agent can self-approve a verify-policy send). Open 4 days 14 hours and 4 days 3 hours. Both unfixed, so the affected claims stay withdrawn from positioning.md

Two items are held with you privately and are deliberately not described here or in any other public file: one pushed to your dashboard 2026-07-19 21:33 UTC (6 days 1 hour, the privacy decision — whether to purge this chamber repo's history of text redacted on 2026-07-20; if you do nothing the redaction stands and nothing degrades), and one pushed 2026-07-25 21:21 UTC (1 hour 22 minutes, which does not degrade quietly and should be read before the older one). Both threads carry what to do, what was already prepared, and what happens if you do nothing

Merge the two claim corrections that follow from the security issues — retinue#26 and retinue#27, open 1 day 15 hours and 1 day 9 hours. Between them the false or unscoped sentence appears in nine public places (README, comparison.md, review.md, .env.example, a gateway docstring, an agent-facing skill file). No new prose needed: the correct wording already exists elsewhere in the same repo in both cases

Create retinue-os/.github and set the org and repo descriptions — chamber#4, open 5 days 20 hours. Draft text is paste-ready in writing/org-profile-README.md; three of four public repos still have no description and no repo in the org has a topic. Its project's expected_by date was today, and it arrived unmet

Allow GitHub Actions to create pull requests — retinue#4, open 5 days 11 hours. check-signal-cli pushes its bump branch and then cannot open the PR, so the automation completes and delivers nothing. Same missing permission as chamber#6, through a different door

Triage the remaining defects in the indexing mechanism the lead story rests on — qlever-dir#8 (blank nodes collide across files; you proposed skolemizing per graph, which Aros answered 2026-07-25) and #10 (a directory created after startup is never watched, which is exactly how the framework's own boot emitters write). #9 in that set is closed and its fix is verified against a fixture covering five symlink shapes

retinue#2 needs a decision rather than a merge now. Its branch docs/calibrate-reindex-latency replaces the docs' "~15 s" with "15-20 s for a small file", and that number is stale: re-measured tonight in this deployment it is 20-25 s, three trials, no code change since — the chamber grew from 340 KB to 1.4 MB. Merging the branch as pushed would write a fresh wrong number into the framework. The replacement wording, with the method and the bounds, is in a comment on the issue (2026-07-25 20:36 UTC). The second branch on that issue, docs/link-provenance-piece, is unaffected and still worth merging

retinue#28 is on main rather than on a branch: PR #22 merged 2026-07-25 15:12 UTC with both items unaddressed — docs/triple-stores.md states the _generated indexing as unconditional, and the model slug is not injective. Aros corrected his own suggested fix in the thread; take the corrected one

review.md is stale on tests and CI: recommendation #2 is done and six statements are now false — retinue#3, open 5 days 18 hours. Two items on its edit list are struck as superseded, with replacements in the thread; the counts it proposed have gone stale twice, so reword without counts rather than refreshing them

Three issues filed since 18:00 tonight, all documentation-class, none urgent: retinue#31 (a skill file calls the settings allowlist a security boundary while review.md calls the same file the project's soft interior), #32 (CLAUDE.md's framework-checkout detection resolves a path that does not exist in this deployment, so the documented PR recipe commits to whichever repo the agent is standing in — the one with a real hazard in it), #33 (the plugin cache is keyed by the source repo's install-time commit, not by a plugin.json version no shipped manifest declares)
